thread:
Olivia: Heads-up — p95 in the global latency panel for /v1/generate spiked ~2x around 09:12 UTC but the endpoint breakdown p95 looks steady. screenshot: https://.../img.png
infra-bot: [alert] aggregate.p95 /v1/generate crossed threshold at 09:12 UTC (rule: rollout-tail-alert). Triggered by routing-weight-change by Tom.
Tom: I pushed a small routing weight tweak to move traffic off fast-path for quota smoothing ~08:45. Didn't expect big tail impact. Could the merge/rollup logic be counting fallback routes weirdly? :thinking_face:
Jia: Quick theory — endpoint breakdown shows per-route p95, but the aggregate panel is a rollup of tdigest across samples. If sample origin metadata gets dropped on fallback, the rollup might mix routes incorrectly and show a heavier tail.
Michelle: I can repro locally. When quota fallback happens we preserve endpoint label but lose the ingress_route tag in the sample encoder. That makes the sample appear as "unknown route" and get merged into the global rollup bucket.
Tom: ah ok. Also remember cost-route batches ~4x bigger than fast-route; larger batching -> longer tails. If fallback increases cost-route share even slightly, aggregate p95 moves.
Jia: Agreed. Two quick checks: sample counts by route and tdigest delta. Run: 
```sql
SELECT ingress_route, count(*) as n, approx_percentile(latency_ms, 0.95) as p95
FROM latency_samples
WHERE endpoint = '/v1/generate' AND ts > now() - interval '30 minutes'
GROUP BY ingress_route
ORDER BY n DESC;
```
This will show if "unknown" route ballooned.
Michelle: Ran that — unknown_route count jumped from ~20 -> 2.1k around 09:12 and its p95 ~820ms. fast-path p95 stays ~120ms. Opened issue https://go/redwood/issue/4523 and a tiny emitter fixing route tag preservation in the sample emitter (PR #9876).
Olivia: Nice find. Can we also annotate the global panel with the rollout commit/issue so oncall knows root cause next time?
Tom: I'll add a dashboard annotation and revert the routing weight for now. Also going to add a canary so we don't lose tags on fallback.
Michelle: Rolling patch to canary nodes now. infra-bot: deploy-started pr=9876 env=canary user=Michelle
Olivia: Cool — once canary looks good, roll to prod. Also propose alert change: default aggregate p95 alert should ignore unknown_route tag or prefer endpoint-scoped p95 to avoid false positives from mis-tagged samples.
Jia: Agreed. I'll draft a small proposal for the alert behavior and a console toggle for "prefer per-endpoint p95" vs "global rollup".
Tom: thx all. Keep the thread updated. :thumbsup:
Michelle: can confirm canary p95 back to baseline after fix. infra-bot: deploy-succeeded pr=9876 env=canary user=Michelle
Olivia: awesome — marking as monitored. last check 09:48 UTC p95 normalized.
